title: Custom Tube Filling Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Input the parameters for your protocol.
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Create CSV file
steps.instruction: Create a CSV file containing the aspiration depth (mm), aspiration speed (µL/s), and dispense speed (µL/s) for each transfer. Include the header line exactly as: `distance down tube to aspirate (in mm),aspiration speed (in ul/s), dispense speed (in ul/s)`. Add rows such as `20,100,100`. Empty lines will be ignored. Download the template from https://opentrons-protocol-library-website.s3.amazonaws.com/custom-README-images/272c63/template.csv if needed.

steps.title: Gather required equipment
steps.instruction: Ensure you have the Opentrons P1000 GEN2 single‑channel electronic pipette, Opentrons 1000 µL tipracks, and the custom 100 mL tubes and custom tube racks required for the experiment.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons protocol builder, input the parameters from your CSV (aspiration depth, aspiration speed, dispense speed) to define the custom tube‑filling scheme.

steps.title: Download generated protocol
steps.instruction: Click the “Download” button to save the generated Python protocol file to your computer.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Open the OT App and use the “Upload” function to load the downloaded protocol file into the robot’s workspace.

steps.title: Set up deck per map
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the provided deck map, placing the tiprack, custom tube rack, and any other labware in the specified slots.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Run the calibration routine in the OT App to calibrate the labware positions, tiprack, and the P1000 pipette.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press the “Run” button in the OT App to start the custom tube‑filling protocol.
